subject: Startups
title: Cohort Analysis
description: A short lesson to help you apply Cohort Analysis.

hook.text: Top-line growth can hide a dying product. Cohort analysis shows whether users from each month stick around.

buildup.text: A cohort is a group of users who signed up in the same time period. You track their behavior over time.

discovery.text: Healthy cohorts flatten into a stable retention curve. Unhealthy ones drop to near-zero within weeks.

twist.text: A company growing fast can mask terrible retention.

climax.text: Investors who understand cohorts can see through vanity growth. Founders who track them can fix problems early.

punchline.text: Cohorts reveal the truth that total numbers hide.

quiz.question: What does cohort analysis reveal that total user numbers don't?
options: Whether users from each time period stick around
